A plugin is a directory with manifest.json in the schema docs/architecture/plugins.md states; shell/Core/PluginLogic.js is the one judge of a manifest and a second validator is a twin. A plugin declares surfaces (kinds), never dependencies; an unknown manifest key is refused by design. A plugin imports qs.Commons, qs.Ui, Qt and Quickshell modules other than Quickshell.Wayland and QtQuick.Window (REFUSED_MODULES in scripts/check-plugin-boundary.py), and its own files; it names no window type and no other plugin. A core action reaches a plugin only through a capability named in the manifest's capabilities list. A bar owns the geometry of its sections and its own built-in widgets; the core mounts every plugin widget into its sections. A new plugin lands with its rows in scripts/qml-smoke.sh, read back from the built instance.
